title: Hearty Creole Okra and Tomatoes
description: This hearty Creole okra and tomatoes recipe is for a great Southern okra dish made with andouille sausage, tomatoes, fresh corn, onions, and celery.
ingredients: 4 ears fresh corn, shucked and kernels scraped from cob
2 (28 ounce) cans whole tomatoes, broken up
2 pounds fresh okra, cut into 1/2 inch slices
0.5 teaspoon Creole seasoning, or to taste
sea salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat butter and olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add celery and onions; cook and stir until onions are translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in corn kernels; cook 3 minutes.

Stir in tomatoes, okra, andouille sausage, and Creole seasoning; cover and cook over medium heat until okra has lost all its slippery texture, at least 45 minutes. Season with salt, black pepper, and Creole seasoning. Cook, uncovered, to reduce liquid, about 10 minutes.
